from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, lower, trim, regexp_replace, to_timestamp, year, month, dayofmonth, hour

 
spark = SparkSession.builder.appName("BronzeToSilver").getOrCreate()
 
df_raw = spark.read.option("recursiveFileLookup", "true").parquet(f"abfss://dlfs5clou-raw@dl5clou.dfs.core.windows.net/")
 
df_clean = (
    df_raw
    .dropDuplicates()
    .withColumn("content", trim(col("content")))
    .withColumn("content", regexp_replace(col("content"), r'\s+', ' '))
    .withColumn("content_lower", lower(col("content")))
    .withColumn("timestamp", to_timestamp(col("created_at")))
)
 
df_clean = (
    df_clean
    .withColumn("year", year(col("timestamp")))
    .withColumn("month", month(col("timestamp")))
    .withColumn("day", dayofmonth(col("timestamp")))
    .withColumn("hour", hour(col("timestamp")))
)
 

(
    df_clean
    .write
    .mode("overwrite")
    .parquet("abfss://dlfs5clou-clean@dl5clou.dfs.core.windows.net/clean/")
